Local vendor libraries for offline use

- Bootstrap 5.3.3 — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/
- Chart.js 4.4.3 — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.3/
- jsPDF 2.5.2 — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.2/
- jsPDF-AutoTable 3.8.4 — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf-autotable@3.8.4/
- FullCalendar 6.1.15 — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fullcalendar@6.1.15/
- SweetAlert2 11.x — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2/
- Manrope local fonts — downloaded from Google Fonts and stored in assets/vendor/fonts/

These files are served locally to keep the system usable on a machine without internet access after the first setup.
